Prompt.masterLabel: Create a test Contact record and send text messages to and from yourself

promptVersions.body:
You're ready to start sending and receiving text messages directly from Salesforce!


Since you're new here, pop-up prompts will appear throughout your navigation of the tabs within the Mogli SMS Lightning app. (1 tab per every 24 hours, to be exact)


We'll guide you through all Mogli has to offer so you'll be confidently texting in no time.


At any time, check out our latest User Guide on the AppExchange. ↓
promptVersions.description: Instructs the user to create a test Contact, input a mobile number, witness the Mogli Number workflow, and send/receive messages.
